# MiniModel.MiRust.com Full Agent Context

MiniModel.MiRust.com is the documentation authority for MiniModel.org catalog
and peer protocols. The product remains prelaunch and clean-slate. No obsolete
format, compatibility route, instruction-file acquisition flow, proxy model
host, remote-inference fallback, hidden retry, or ambiguous alias is current.

## Catalog And Byte Flow

MiniModel.org is a metadata catalog. It supports direct P2P discovery but does not proxy model bytes.
Exact qualified SLM2 composition bytes may move directly
between consenting peers. When no exact qualified peer exists, an installed
local companion may acquire a pinned source and perform an explicit local
conversion. The user sees which route is active.

A catalog entry binds exact source and license provenance, composition and
profile identity, member names/sizes/digests, qualification claims, runtime
requirements, fixed piece boundaries and hashes, and expiring peer
announcements. Aliases do not point to different bytes.

## Transfer Contract

Multi-peer import requires complete identity agreement before pieces are
mixed, bounded concurrency, range validation, per-piece cryptographic checks,
durable progress, corruption quarantine, whole-member verification, and atomic
activation. A matching piece hash does not establish composition
qualification.

Local conversion requires immutable source resolution, license and source-card
review, storage/resource admission, exact acquisition locks, one registered
conversion, independent inspection, and qualification evidence before
installation. Acquisition must perform the requested operation rather than
produce a text handoff.

Project sites receive no prompts or model bytes. Logs and public receipts omit
credentials, invitation URLs, local paths, raw private evidence, and user
content.

## MemoryEndpoints Two-Lane Policy

MemoryEndpoints.com has two separate authorized uses across the ecosystem:

1. Agents on all maintained sites use it directly for agent-to-agent long-term
   memory, meetings, handoffs, and coordination.
2. Separately, the TinyRustLM.com Connect plugin lets a user explicitly sign in
   and select MemoryEndpoints.com as TinyRustLM.com Connect long-term memory.

The direct agent lane and user plugin lane have separate identity, credentials,
consent, scopes, provenance, idempotency, and receipts. Neither silently acts
for the other. MemoryEndpoints.com is not a model-byte transport, catalog,
relay, or inference service.

Prelaunch resilience may duplicate important memory in current .uai, wiki,
source-controlled public-safe notes, and approved private stores. Every
maintained copy remains current, secret-safe, provenance-labeled, and
noncontradictory. Conflicts are surfaced and reconciled rather than silently
resolved.

Configuration and reachability do not prove live meetings, synchronization,
restore, deletion, continuity, peer availability, or public readback. Exact
claims require matching receipts.

## Publication Record

Last published: 1.1.0.
Release date: 2026-08-28.
Update: published current direct P2P, SLM2, cryptographic identity, privacy,
evidence, and exact two-use MemoryEndpoints authority; retired obsolete .slm,
manifest-v0, verifier-MVP, fixture, and instruction-handoff authority.

Public release requires a clean committed revision, complete tests and
documentation, deployment from that revision, and exact HTTPS readback. Site
reachability or source control alone does not satisfy that gate.
